stories.title: 5 things therapists wish you’d stop saying to your adult kids
stories.summary: If you’re looking forward to spending time with your grown children this Thanksgiving, here are some common phrases to avoid and what to say instead.

stories.title: Army: Entire U.S. stockpile of lead azide is at Iowa plant and set to be detonated Wednesday morning
stories.summary: The controlled detonation of five tons of bomb-making materials has set off concerns about potential health and environmental effects and frustration over a lack of information.

stories.title: DEA allowed 1.4 million fentanyl pills to go unseized in major probe
stories.summary: Agency’s decision to stand down fit a pattern that would play out as agents allowed staggering amounts of the deadly drug to hit the streets.

stories.title: In Costa Rica, simple rope bridges offer sloths a lifeline as forests disappear
stories.summary: The project aims to reduce injuries and deaths from vehicles, power lines and predators, while efforts to restore tree cover offer longer-term protection.

stories.title: Nvidia and other AI stocks fall, but the rest of Wall Street rises with confidence in US economy
stories.summary: It’s the latest swing for a market that has been mostly sinking since setting its all-time high last month.

stories.title: Why Trump believed he needed to get Jensen Huang back on top at AI behemoth Nvidia
stories.summary: The stock market had plunged since Huang’s departure, and Trump feared he might be poached by a Chinese company.

stories.title: How retailers make a Black Friday sale look better than it is

stories.title: Trump administration blacklists Megaspeed, key firm in Nvidia scandal
